Hello, Dr. Hishida. I really like the atmosphere of your painting! If you don't mind, I would like to paint my ooc. The setting and kingdom style of their story is a western fantasy continent similar to Germany.

Silk (170 cm)
Fantasy writer with low self-esteem. He was once an evil dragon who rules death, and his power is still sleeping. Basically, he has no desire to fight, but under the influence of past events, he can lose his sanity when he is stimulated to a certain degree.
She has distinctive asymmetrical bangs, braids like a dragon's tail, and a long costume reminiscent of a dragon's wings. Although graceful in appearance, her inner life is delicate and complex.

Recht (185cm)
Born into a family of knights who fought against evil for generations, he gave up the honor of knighthood to become an adventurer and a great swordsman. Confident and sometimes reckless, he is the heir to the will of the brave. Stubborn and prone to recklessness, he is always on the lookout for the possibility of his opponent going out of control, and he cannot leave Silk alone and follows him around.

Their Relationship
They are an odd duo who work together despite their quarrels. They don't call each other by their first names, and they are like friends in a fight.
Their common interests include eating, fishing, camping, art salons, and fighting. In everyday life, though, they are on a temporary truce. Recently, they have been working mainly on requests from adventurers and writers. When they fight seriously, they both fight with all their might...this is the test of a brave man.

Feel free to choose costumes for your characters! We would appreciate it if you could create your own interpretation of the atmosphere, composition, direction, etc., as well as the teacher's freedom!
Please use a screen ratio of 16:9 landscape. I would like to use it as wallpaper on my computer.

The image is for personal use only. We would be happy if you could draw freely!
Thank you for your consideration!
More settings are available in the URL.

I came across your tighnari artworks and found the attention to detail and cozy atmosphere so incredibly charming, I'd be very honored if I could commission you for a 16:9 illustration of my character to use as a wallpaper.

Feel free to do what you like!!! 
If the amount is too little, please feel free to resend me an appeal with the desired amount, thank you so much, truly!!!!!!!!!

Nice to meet you, I love your work! I would like to ask you to draw my character if you would be willing to do so!
Below are the specific requirements for your request.
Her name is Nico and she has a lovely personality. She always has a little rabbit with her, which symbolizes beautiful love. The theme of the illustration is "kind young lady". As for the outfit, you may either design it for the teacher or use this outfit. It would be nice if the scene could be like having afternoon tea in a flowery garden. Of course, if the teacher has a better idea, you can use it as much as you like, focusing on the natural scenery. It would be great if you could draw the background as well.
Thank you very much and I would be very happy if you could send it to me as PSD data!
Scope of use Personal use and use in free works
